races.paceDynamic: Rebel Queen will likely set the early pace with minimal pressure, creating a sustainable tempo that should suit the large contingent of hold-up horses. The race will develop into a tactical affair with most runners held up for late challenges, making it crucial for the pace-setters to maintain galloping room turning for home.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Suits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Rebel Queen maintains a steady gallop without being pressed early
scenarios.body: The moderate early pace allows prominent runners to stay in touch and finish strongly. Late challengers struggle to make up ground on the leaders who conserve energy.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too strong or Rebel Queen ties up
scenarios.body: The front runners fade badly in the final furlong after setting unsustainable fractions. Hold-up horses with the strongest finishing kicks benefit most from the pace collapse.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Rebel Queen goes too slow and the field bunches up approaching the final hurdle
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical crawl leading to a chaotic sprint finish where positioning and traffic luck matter most. Horses with proven finishing speed and jumping ability thrive in the melee.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Newcomer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If one of the lightly-raced fillies shows unexpectedly strong form on debut over hurdles
scenarios.body: The unraced fillies prove far superior to their experienced rivals who have exposed limitations. Superior natural ability overcomes lack of experience in a weak maiden field.

How the three newcomers jump and travel compared to their experienced but limited rivals

races.paceDynamic: Manoir De Mirande will take the field along at a steady gallop with little pressure from the lightly-raced newcomers and predominantly hold-up runners behind. With Crooked Path the only prominent runner to challenge early, the pace will be controlled and sustainable, setting up a tactical finish where stamina and jumping efficiency become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Manoir De Mirande maintains his rhythm and jumps cleanly throughout
scenarios.body: The leader gets an easy time of it and has enough left to resist late challengers. The hold-up brigade struggle to make significant inroads against solid jumping and tactical awareness.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and bunches the field for a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The hold-up runners get their ideal scenario with a strong pace injection in the final half-mile. Superior class tells when horses hit top gear simultaneously.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Newcomer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If one of the lightly-raced horses shows significantly more ability than expected
scenarios.body: Fresh legs and unexposed talent prove decisive as the race unfolds at a rhythm that suits progressive types. Experience counts for less than raw ability and good jumping.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Stamina Test
scenarios.trigger: If the soft ground and 2-mile trip catches out several runners in the final quarter-mile
scenarios.body: The race becomes a war of attrition where proven stayers with soft ground form come to the fore. Jumping errors or stamina lapses eliminate several contenders.

races.paceDynamic: Listentomewillya is the only confirmed front-runner and should get an uncontested lead, setting a sustainable pace without pressure from the predominantly hold-up field. With nine of twelve runners preferring to come from behind, the race will develop into a late-developing finish where positioning and stamina become crucial over the final 3-4 furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Listentomewillya gets easy fractions and stays on strongly
scenarios.body: The leader builds an insurmountable advantage while the hold-up brigade leave too much to do in testing soft ground conditions. Brackens Jet and El Phenomeno emerge best of the prominent/midfield runners but can't peg back the winner.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses time their challenges perfectly and find the leader vulnerable
scenarios.body: Thisain'tthat and Endless Talking produce strong finishes to overwhelm a tiring Listentomewillya in the final furlong. The soft ground plays to their stamina strengths despite giving the leader first run.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Brackens Jet and El Phenomeno avoid their usual fading tendencies
scenarios.body: The two prominent runners track Listentomewillya perfectly and kick clear when the hold-up horses are still making ground. Their tactical positioning proves decisive over the pure hold-up merchants.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Listentomewillya stops dramatically and all hold-up horses struggle
scenarios.body: The soft ground and modest pace creates a messy finish where fitness and jumping become more important than class. Blazing Duke's stamina or Royal Belief's experience could prove decisive in a war of attrition.

watchPoints.text: Monitor if Listentomewillya gets too easy a lead early - could prove unstoppable if allowed to dictate completely
Watch Thisain'tthat and Endless Talking for market confidence - any strong support suggests connections expect big runs
Check if Brackens Jet or El Phenomeno adopt more aggressive tactics to avoid their usual fading finishes
Observe Royal Belief's jumping - any mistakes will end chances given his tendency to weaken anyway
Look for Blazing Duke traveling well turning in - unknown stamina could be trump card if race develops slowly

races.paceDynamic: Rebel Cowgirl and Millie B will contest the early lead, with both having pace-setting styles but concerning fade patterns. This dual engagement up front should create an honest gallop that will test their stamina over this extended trip, potentially setting up the race for the large contingent of hold-up horses to come from behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Rebel Cowgirl and Millie B duel early and fade badly in the closing stages
scenarios.body: The extended gallop will suit the proven stayers among the hold-up horses who can time their runs. Shellrunforbriggs and Elsannah have the class and finishing kick to capitalize on a collapsed pace scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Battle
scenarios.trigger: If one of the front-runners maintains their effort while the other fades, creating uneven pace pressure
scenarios.body: A more controlled tempo allows prominent runners like Roccabaker to stay closer and the better hold-up horses to still finish strongly. The race becomes more tactical with positioning crucial in the straight.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Early Leader Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Rebel Cowgirl gets an uncontested lead with Millie B dropping back early
scenarios.body: The pace becomes more sedate allowing the leader to conserve energy for a sustained finish. Rebel Cowgirl's recent win from the front on soft ground makes her dangerous if allowed easy fractions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Pace Development
scenarios.trigger: If both pace-setters are restrained early creating a slowly-run race with a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace creates a bunched field and cavalry charge finish where class and a turn of foot matter most. Higher-rated horses with tactical speed have the advantage in a sprint scenario.

races.paceDynamic: Sophia Rose and Syracus Du Houx will likely set the early pace with Teescomponentsyess tracking prominently, creating a moderate gallop rather than breakneck speed. The large field of hold-up horses including Malbas, Hello Jack, and Midnight Moonshine will bunch behind the leaders, setting up a tactical finish where stamina and jumping accuracy become crucial on the testing soft ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If the early leaders tire dramatically from the 3-out, allowing late closers full rein
scenarios.body: The moderate early pace becomes pedestrian when Sophia Rose and Syracus Du Houx weaken, giving the patient hold-up horses perfect conditions. Malbas and Hello Jack capitalize with their superior ratings while Midnight Moonshine benefits from the true test of stamina.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Sophia Rose maintains her effort to the home turn with Teescomponentsyess still tracking
scenarios.body: The pace stays honest but not punishing, creating a fair test where class and jumping matter most. The prominent racers get first run while the hold-up brigade faces a traffic-laden charge from the back.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Messy Jumping Disrupts
scenarios.trigger: If multiple fallers or bad jumps scatter the field and break the rhythm of favorites
scenarios.body: The soft ground causes jumping errors that reshape the race completely, favoring sure-footed horses who avoid trouble. Duffys Hodey and Way Down South benefit from their excellent soft ground records while others struggle with fluency.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sprint Finish Develops
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is very steady until a furious acceleration from 2-out catches hold-up horses cold
scenarios.body: The early moderate pace suddenly ignites into a sprint finish that favors horses positioned prominently or with tactical speed. Teescomponentsyess and any hold-up horse close enough to respond quickly will thrive while the back markers are stranded.

Duffys Hodey's exceptional soft ground record makes him dangerous despite his moderate rating if the ground plays to type
Teescomponentsyess could benefit significantly if positioned closer to the pace than his usual hold-up style suggests

races.paceDynamic: Mount Frisco and Doyen Magic will ensure genuine early pace as both prefer to lead, creating an honest gallop from the start. The five hold-up horses will benefit from this setup, with the soft ground helping stamina types over 2m2f. This pace battle between the front pair should set up a strong finish for the closers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Closers Benefit Strong Pace
scenarios.trigger: If Mount Frisco and Doyen Magic duel early and weaken
scenarios.body: The genuine gallop plays into the hands of the hold-up brigade who can pick up the pieces. Quest With Speed and Spinning Web are best positioned to capitalize with their proven closing ability.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Mount Frisco gets an uncontested lead while Doyen Magic settles
scenarios.body: Mount Frisco can dictate terms and has the class to see off challenges, especially with recent heavy ground form. His OR 112 gives him a solid chance if avoiding the early battle.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is steady early then quickens dramatically late
scenarios.body: Come On The Lads and Marelly benefit from a tactical affair that becomes a sprint finish. Both have shown ability to win from the back when the race develops into a dash.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Doyen Magic Wire Job
scenarios.trigger: If Doyen Magic settles better than expected behind Mount Frisco
scenarios.body: Despite the low OR 95, Doyen Magic has been running well in better company recently. A patient ride could see him spring a surprise at decent odds.

Quest With Speed needs to be positioned within striking distance turning for home given the small field
